# Border

GameCore theme sourced from a **real design object** in the Art Institute of Chicago.

## Work
- **Title:** Border
- **Artist / Maker:** Egypt, probably Akhmin
- **Date:** Greco–Roman period (30 BCE– 641 CE), 4th/5th century
- **Style / Period:** greco-roman (egyptian)
- **Classification:** textile
- **Department:** Textiles
- **AIC artwork ID:** 1834
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/1834
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/d4e06812-6bb2-63c1-43c9-bc21da19328d/full/400,/0/default.jpg

## Extracted Source Palette
`#D8C8A8, #382828, #584838, #887858, #785848, #B89878, #988878, #B8A898`
